'''Bakuran bitters''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] questioned [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Mason Simpson]] of [[Salis D'aar Academy]] about the [[Ssi-ruu]]k's base-12 mathematics over several mugs of Bakuran bitters in a pub.
